This is Overwatch. Your whole S V S, planned and timed for you.
When the draw lands, Overwatch finds your opponent, and every member votes when they can play.
A day before the battle, the plan builds itself. The strongest defenders hold the castle, and rally leads swap every pet block.
Six hours out, everyone gets their own orders. Their rally, their hero, their formation.
In battle, coordinators call the enemy rallies they see in game.
Now the part no one else has. Every garrison player gets a personal countdown, from their own march time, on one shared clock.
Send on zero, and your reinforcements land in the six second gap between two enemy rallies. The castle stays yours.
And when it's over, everyone gets the result.
Overwatch. Try the free demo at woss overwatch dot com.
